notes.q_construction: independent piecewise integration of the two Discop distribution copies over each Huffman node
notes.reference_normalization: for validation only, canonical FP32 P_reference is converted to FP64 and divided by its FP64 sum to remove storage-level unit-sum residuals before KL/TVD; no generation-policy or stegomethod transformation is applied
notes.main_adapter: ordinary normalized Discop runs use explicit Q_stego from the independent piecewise-integration calculator; no reference-equality certificate is used
